name: What are the common challenges in home addition plumbing?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges in home addition plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in home addition plumbing include ensuring adequate water pressure for new fixtures, correctly sizing drain pipes for proper waste removal, and tying into existing systems without causing issues. Identifying the best routes for new pipes to minimize structural impact, ensuring proper venting, and meeting current building codes are also significant considerations that require professional expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include ensuring water pressure, proper drain sizing, integrating with existing systems, and meeting building codes.
